description: Limba Demo stands in for a monitor brightness app: it adjusts the brightness of external displays and can dim below 0%.
context: People who use it have one or more external monitors. Brightness and thresholds are numbers with units that stay as written: % and lux.

glossary.note: Dimming below 0% brightness by darkening the picture in software. Zero means 0% brightness, not a temperature.
Copies the built-in display's brightness to external monitors
The macOS feature that warms the screen colors at night; use the name macOS uses in the target language
